response.sql:
WITH project_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    SUM(ss.boxx) AS total_boxx,
    SUM(ss.boxz) AS total_boxz
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss
    ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    arcregistry,
    fundflux,
    total_boxx / NULLIF(total_boxz, 0) AS ratio
  FROM project_totals
), project_excess AS (
  SELECT
    arcregistry,
    fundflux,
    ratio,
    ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS excess
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, excess
FROM project_excess
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Projects are included in the funding-source average only when they have at least one matching spatial record; missing box values are ignored by SUM, and a zero or missing boxz total yields a NULL ratio, excluded from AVG.
